==================
lexical: keywords and identifier classes
==================

struct HTTPServer { id: int }

const MAX_SIZE: int = 1_000
const HEX: int = 0xFF
const BITS: int = 0b1010_1010

fn make_thing() -> int { MAX_SIZE }

---

  (struct_declaration
    name: (type_identifier)

      (list_lbrace)

        name: (identifier)
        type: (type
          (primitive_type)))
      (rbrace)))
  (const_declaration
    name: (constant)
    type: (type
      (primitive_type))
    value: (integer_literal))
  (const_declaration
    name: (constant)
    type: (type
      (primitive_type))
    value: (integer_literal))
  (const_declaration
    name: (constant)
    type: (type
      (primitive_type))
    value: (integer_literal))
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    return_type: (type
      (primitive_type))
    body: (block
      (block_lbrace)
      (expression_statement
        expression: (constant))
      (rbrace))))

==================
lexical: numeric literals
==================

fn main() {
    let a = 42
    let b = 1_000_000
    let c = 0xDEAD_BEEF
    let d = 0b1010_1010
    let e = 1.5
    let f = 2.0e-3
    let g = 1e9
    let h = -9223372036854775807
}

==================
lexical: strings and escapes
==================

fn main() {
    let text = "line\n tab\t quote\" slash\\ brace\{ brace\} unicode\u{1F600}"
    let empty = ""
}

==================
lexical: comments and doc comments
==================

/// Main entry point.
fn main() {
    // a line comment
    let value = 1 // trailing comment
    /// This is an ordinary comment here.
    let other = value + 1
    print("{other}")
}

  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)
    body: (block
      (block_lbrace)
      (let_statement

          (binding_pattern

        value: (integer_literal))

        value: (additive_expression
          left: (identifier)
          right: (integer_literal)))
      (expression_statement
        expression: (call_expression
          function: (identifier)

            (argument
              value: (string
                (interpolation
                  value: (identifier)))))))
      (rbrace))))
